# remnawave_nodes (Data Source)

Lists all Remnawave nodes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "remnawave_nodes" "all" {}

output "all_nodes" {
  value = data.remnawave_nodes.all.nodes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
